The UK’s maritime agency says a tugboat near the Strait of Hormuz has been hit by two projectiles, while gunmen fired on an LNG tanker off the coast of Yemen.
The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen claims downing more drones near Riyadh and says two troops have been killed in a helicopter crash in Saudi Arabia’s Najran.
